turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I'm Meredith Kalinowski, Owen's mother. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's start with why my son got a zero without anyone calling me.
I didn't come to be thanked, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I want to walk you through what I found in the version history.
Version history of what, Hale, and who pulled it? I'm writing that down, along with the dates. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero went in.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on who decided to enter it and whether Owen was spoken to first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with the zero still standing and nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
